# SEO & Conversion Skill
1. Review title/description, canonical, robots, sitemap, headings, alt text and internal links.
2. Ensure category/product pages have distinct accurate metadata where supported.
3. Improve static copy for delivery, pickup, order steps and contact only from verified policy.
4. Make primary actions descriptive and visible without deceptive urgency.
5. Recommend privacy-conscious funnel measurement with zero-cost default.
6. Track qualified sessions, product views, add-to-cart, checkout starts and valid order handoff where instrumentation exists.
7. Never fabricate reviews, guarantees, scarcity, discounts or product specs.
